item.title: Pentagon prepares for weeks of ground operations in Iran
item.summary: If President Trump approves the plans, such an effort would mark a new phase of the war that could be significantly more dangerous to U.S. troops than the first four weeks.

item.title: Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen launch attack on Israel for first time in war
item.summary: The missile attack by the Houthis in Yemen marks an escalation of the war in the Middle East and may pose further risks to shipping in the region.

item.title: Dread deepens among U.S. allies in Asia over a protracted Mideast war
item.summary: Japan, Taiwan and other Asian countries that rely on the U.S. for security worry that the Iran war is drawing American military assets and focus away from containing China.

item.title: As Iran war drags on, food and medicine for millions is stuck in limbo
item.summary: The war has disrupted shipping routes, raised fuel and insurance prices, closed airports, and left aid groups with tons of essential supplies stuck in warehouses.

item.title: At least 10 U.S. troops wounded in Iranian attack on Saudi air base
item.summary: The strike on Prince Sultan Air Base also damaged at least two Air Force refueling aircraft and underscored that despite weeks of strikes, Iran still poses a threat.

item.title: Nearly 1,500 Iranian civilians killed in U.S., Israeli strikes, report says
item.summary: The findings appear to be the most comprehensive estimates yet of the growing toll of dead and wounded civilians in the month-long war.

item.title: U.S. uses hundreds of Tomahawk missiles on Iran, alarming some at Pentagon
item.summary: More than 850 Tomahawks have been fired in just four weeks, people familiar with the matter said, alarming some Pentagon officials because the weapon’s supply is limited.

item.title: Cuba looks to Vatican for help as U.S. pressure plunges island into crisis
item.summary: Cuban officials have petitioned Pope Leo XIV to help persuade the Trump administration to ease its oil embargo, which is causing crippling fuel shortages and blackouts.
